d:
A massive, serpentine dragon species with iridescent obsidian scales and sweeping, jagged horns. The head features glowing violet eyes and a maw of jagged white teeth, while the long, whip-like tail ends in a sharp, obsidian spade. Two expansive, leathery wings with tattered edges sprout from the shoulders, and each limb possesses four sharp, midnight-black claws.
BODY COLOR: obsidian black
